About the Sherwood Park service area

Sherwood Park is Strathcona County's urban core, just east of Edmonton off Highway 16 and Highway 21. It's a community of family neighbourhoods and generous lots, which means a steady mix of work: bright repaints for busy households, refreshes ahead of listings, and repairs done properly rather than patched.

Chris Lloyd Ltd paints Sherwood Park interiors and exteriors year-round — walls, ceilings, trim, fascias and doors — with tidy prep and a clean finish. Reach out through the contact section on the main site for a quote.

Where we're coming from: the shop is at 10412 66 Ave NW in west Edmonton; Sherwood Park is in Strathcona County, just east of Edmonton — about twenty minutes from downtown via the henday ring road.

Painting & renovation services in Sherwood Park

The same interior, exterior and renovation work the main site describes, phrased for Sherwood Park homes.

Interior Painting

Sherwood Park interior painting: walls, ceilings, trim and woodwork, with tidy prep and clean lines. Furniture and floors are masked and protected; dust is minimised rather than swept under the drop sheet.

Exterior Painting

Sherwood Park exterior work: fascias, soffits, doors, garage siding and masonry accents, prepped and coated to hold up to an Alberta winter. Repairs and rot checks are flagged before the first brush stroke.

Renovation & Touch-Ups

Sherwood Park renovation support: drywall repair and painting, small refreshes, and finishing touch-ups around the rest of the job. Handover-ready rather than almost-finished.
